reason: MEDIUM → HARD is the lowest-scoring feasible plan in 7,035 simulated candidates for Alexander Albon at Sakhir in 2024. It uses 1 pit stop(s) with stint lengths 18, 39; the estimate includes a 22-second loss per stop and the fitted tyre degradation. The physical set, dry-compound-diversity, and tyre-age constraints passed before ranking. The next-ranked candidate scores 0.01 seconds higher. Lap-time estimates blend the Random Forest with historical tyre profiles.
